I can't compute the embedded emissions yet because the CN code is missing. The ruleset requires a good CN code from the table, and "steel goods" doesn't identify one. The default factor is selected by the pair (CN code, country), so the code determines which factor applies.

The table has four India entries, each with a different default SEE:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen, in pigs, blocks or other primary forms | 2.53 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, of iron and non-alloy steel (excl. remelted scrap ingots) | 2.64 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 4.32 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations, ribs, etc. | 4.27 |

Once you confirm the CN code, the calculation is:

**Embedded emissions (tCO2e) = SEE for that code and India × 3,000 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

Please provide the CN code for the 3,000 t of India-produced goods.
